clarifications_for_future_design: Keep namespace/boot/process identity and device generation distinct; use pidfd only for its process identity/death meaning.
A B recovery open is not a revocation mechanism and equal node fstat cannot prove independent OFDs.
Current clean restart snapshots cannot certify the former session; do not overwrite originals before reconciliation.
Avoid claiming all close work is deferred after exit: normal exit_files and exit_task_work are ordered; extra references and unreturned operations are the material uncertainty.
confirmed: Per-open state vs duplicate references is correct.
No current persistent physical lease/journal is correct.
Snapshot rebaseline is a source prediction to test, not a claimed runtime result.
Draft distinguishes child death, final close and all capability references correctly.
First proposed negative retains wait137 as an expected kill fact while leaving recovery assertions FAIL; noIMPORT restart preserves original baseline.
Draft correctly leaves write-ahead/ACK/helper restart/concurrency and non-revocable FD capability unresolved.

findings.text: Each usbfs open allocates a new usb_dev_state and stores it in struct file private_data. Claim bits and pending/completed URB lists belong to that open file description, not a numeric FD or application PID.

Only final struct file reference release invokes usbdev_release; it releases owned interfaces and destroys/frees its async requests. Closing one duplicate, losing the helper socket, or observing one child exit is not equivalent to proving that final reference released.

Ordinary exit_files closes that task file table; do_exit then runs exit_task_work. Do not claim release is always deferred after wait. The missing premise is absence of other references, including fork/dup/SCM_RIGHTS queues or another process, and any unreturned kernel operation.

The helper opens a fixed validated character node, hands the FD through SCM_RIGHTS, then drops its local grant at serve_connection return. ManagedState records Native exports/ports only, so there is no retained physical capability lease or crash journal.

A watchdog retaining a dup/SCM_RIGHTS copy of the worker FD keeps the same usbfs state alive after child SIGKILL. It must not simultaneously assume kernel last-close cleanup occurred. Do not wrap a shared OFD in a second independent nusb event loop and steal the child completions.

A second independent open is a separate usbfs state. Its RELEASEINTERFACE cannot release another state claim: its own ifclaimed bit is absent. It cannot reconstruct or reap the dead nusb allocator requests; recovery must first resolve old ownership. Equal fstat node/inode values do not distinguish dup from independent open.

Kernel release/unbind does not possess the application original-driver/configuration transaction. Unbind can reset alternate0; no source chain restores the previously detached application driver. USBDEVFS_CONNECT merely runs driver probing and does not select the saved driver by name.

Current no-reattach claim deliberately disables the nusb destructor reconnect path. release_checked is an explicit one-shot live-owner operation. SIGKILL bypasses Rust destructors and loses the private Worker state; it does not turn the capability into a revocable lease.

PhysicalDeviceSnapshot is diagnostic, without receipt, original alternates, separate original configuration, owned_original set, configuration_changed flag, or in-progress Special transaction. Slot.source/private Worker hold these only in process memory. Serialize(snapshot) alone cannot authorize post-crash restoration.

Helper ensure_eligible does not reject every unbound interface. initialize derives original_drivers from fresh grant metadata and marks an independently consistent newly registered slot clean/available. A post-crash unbound device may therefore become the new original. The planned no-IMPORT first-restart negative must establish the actual result; no run was performed by this review.

Existing recovery checks same generation/configuration, historical actually owned interfaces and whether configuration was changed by this worker. Reuse those checks; do not create a fresh Slot that silently replaces the saved baseline or treat a fresh journal-less FD as old ownership.

limitations: Linux v6.8 tag resolves to recorded immutable e8f897f... commit; official sources and exact SHA/Git blobs saved. Ubuntu6.8.0-106 is a separate build requiring guest runtime evidence. Tag signature was not independently verified.
No existing SIGTERM matrix was rerun or relabeled as SIGKILL evidence.
Independent FD plus journal plus pidfd is not FD revocation. A malicious/forwarding holder, surviving descendant, or helper death can leave old capability references.
Neither journal nor recovery can undo already delivered OUT/vendor-control side effects or resurrect trustworthy completion counters lost with process memory.
A small persisted restart-denial gate is the recommended first implementation, while general automatic recovery requires approved protocol/ownership and crash-gap design.
must_refuse_or_quarantine: Missing, corrupt, oversized, stale-schema, non-root-owned journal or failed durable write/rename/fsync; do not fabricate a baseline.
Unresolved managed lease or other live worker epoch; do not grant again merely because current interfaces show None.
PID alone or pidfd readability without the capability-reference/descendant/forwarded-FD assumptions; never signal a reused PID.
Unknown in-flight host-state intent or missing result ACK, especially configuration/alternate changes; do not replay transfers or assume side effects absent.
Changed boot/device/node/sysfs/address generation, ambiguous fingerprint or hot reinsert; classify old generation Gone and require new explicit authorization.
Foreign usbfs/usbip-host/kernel ownership, unknown interface set, unsafe/storage/block descendants, or state outside the last confirmed transition; do not detach a new driver.
Independent B cannot release old A claims; RELEASEINTERFACE error/Busy is not success or authority to force unbind.
Kernel ioctl still active, unreconciled old OFD references, or bounded cleanup timeout; quarantine and report rather than drop a future and advertise Available.

Original driver None with nonzero alternate is not generically solved: release can reset alternate0. Preserve independent final checks and report unsupported/unresolved recovery rather than inventing success.
Helper/supervisor restart loses live pidfd/FD handles; journal survives only metadata, not kernel ownership. Reconcile before new grants.
New driver probe yields a different binding, descriptor or config differs, or actual original verification fails; do not detach/retry blindly.
Do not blanket-reject every legitimate original driver=None device. The new gate applies to known unresolved leases, not all unbound hardware.

nusb.scope: Reviewed current vendored Linux API/cleanup source and provenance, not rerun all 70 original-file checks or compilation.

recommended_minimum.candidate_future_recovery: For a confirmed stable interrupted session only: deny regrant, verify known child termination plus capability reference/ownership contract, wait bounded for old usbfs claims to cease, recheck exact generation/current safety/state, apply only confirmed own restoration through B, then independent final original-state checks. Unknown/blocked cleanup remains quarantined; clear record only after verification.
recommended_minimum.helper_watchdog_boundary: Helper may deny grants and record/query bounded leases; a future typed recovery action must derive fixed node/interface/baseline from its own authorized record. Do not accept arbitrary PID, path, driver, ioctl, executable or restoration snapshot. An ordinary supervisor with B can perform allowed usbfs ioctls without making the network server root. If helper executes recovery itself it must preserve the same narrow checks and bounded ownership, not become a USB/IP data parser.
recommended_minimum.immediate_scope: Perform only the planned isolated SIGKILL + first restart without IMPORT negative on unchanged product. Preserve original baseline, wait137, missing stopped and actual restart snapshots. No automatic-recovery product implementation is justified by this review alone.
journal_minimum: schema/length bounds, helper/session epoch and authenticated caller UID; boot_id plus process PID/starttime/UID/exe identity (pidfd live handle when available)
complete PhysicalDeviceReceipt plus device fingerprint, descriptor identity and bus/address; do not use Bus ID/VIDPID alone
immutable original configuration and each original interface number/alternate/driver, captured by trusted helper observation
phase, monotonically increasing operation ID, claim/configuration/alternate intent, prior confirmed state, known actual owned interfaces, terminal errno and scoped observed post-state

dirty mark durably committed before capability handoff or a mutation is permitted; bounded root-owned non-symlink storage, atomic replacement and fsync policy; write/parse/checksum/schema failure blocks grants
clean/recovered only after old ownership is resolved and independent same-generation original config/alt/driver checks complete; no raw payload, device serial, raw pointer or transfer replay
recommended_minimum.larger_alternative: Moving actual USB ownership/Worker into an ordinary separate process surviving frontend death avoids losing private transaction state for frontend SIGKILL, but adds a bounded USB request IPC and still does not solve that owner own SIGKILL or FD forwarding. Do not call it the minimal current patch.
recommended_minimum.next_minimal_product_unit: A managed physical lease/restart gate in the existing helper, not a new generic broker or root network parser. Persist immutable pre-grant baseline plus device/process epochs before sending a usable capability. Refuse a second grant while the prior managed record is unresolved; no overwrite with newly observed None.
recommended_minimum.ordinary_supervisor: Prefer one ordinary supervisor owning its fixed child identity and bounded control channel, with helper retaining authorization/journal and per-device grant arbitration. If a recovery capability is retained, create a genuinely independent open B; do not retain worker open A through dup merely for observation. No runtime-only duplicate prevents all foreign references, so the trust/FD-forwarding boundary remains explicit.
recommended_minimum.restart_order: On helper restart load and validate unresolved journal before granting devices. Surviving old capability holders remain authoritative uncertainty. Do not reopen/regrant a replacement generation automatically, delete stale journal on PID absence, or infer revocation from helper socket loss.
recommended_minimum.write_ahead_ack: A typed mutation requires a persisted intent ACK before the worker acts, and a persisted terminal/result observation before its epoch can become a recovery-authorized stable state. Death between intent and confirmed result leaves uncertainty, not permission to replay or undo. This does not eliminate external-admin TOCTOU.
